page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core configuration without hyperthreading. This architecture ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU, minimizing resource contention.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 1.85 GB per core. It does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, managed via the KVM hypervisor. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers high compute density with dedicated physical cores, making it suitable for compute-bound workloads where hyperthreading overhead must be avoided. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs focuses its resource allocation entirely on raw CPU execution and high-throughput networking. This profile is appropriate for high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive scientific simulations, and large-scale web serving workloads.
